title: Auth Control Plane invite (v1 wire format)
description: An invitation to join an organization. It carries no e-mail address, no hint of one and no token: the token reaches the invitee out of band and is never served back.

schema_version.description: Contract identifier. A reader MUST reject an unrecognised value (G-26: unknown denies).

invite_id.description: Invite id. Server-minted, never copied from caller input.

role.description: An organization role key of the closed catalog (contracts/auth/v1/vocabulary/roles.v1.json). A platform role, superuser and every other value are refused.

expires_at.description: Instant after which the invite cannot be accepted.

revision.description: Aggregate revision (provisioning-event.v1 payload.revision). Integer token only; a decimal-form token is refused by every client (README, integer guard).
